trigger.summary: A physically Connected connector still had a stale installed reference or an unresolvable generated data-source alias.

invariant: A live runtime is GREEN only when the physical connection is Connected, current and installed logical and physical references match, and the generated data-source alias equals the full alias registered by the host.

red.testName: RED: a Connected physical connection does not prove the installed logical binding

green.testName: GREEN: matching current and installed references plus the full alias pass

positiveControl.testName: positive control: an independent valid connector binding remains GREEN
